ordering.before: Layout IPC could leave an animation callback before its browser rendering task completed. A retained native frame combined enlarged image geometry with preceding divider/grid paint.
ordering.after: The session serializes the measured DTO cohort, then waits for an animation callback followed by a later task before dispatch. It never remeasures into that staged cohort. Source replacement, unregister, reconnect and disposal cancel stale staged work; empty withdrawal bypasses the rendering wait. Suppressed rendering has a 1500ms bound and uses existing failure/reconnect handling.
ordering.limit: A rendering opportunity is not a compositor-present acknowledgement. Acceptance is based on the actual recorded native sequences below, not an untested claim of universally atomic presentation.
